summary: Iteration 3 tests the new workflow-alignment features: admin doc-requests, pending_items on client GET, auto-fulfill on matching upload, Waiting-on-Documents status email with pending list, client portal pending banner with 'Upload now' deep-link, admin DocRequestsPanel UI, wizard deep-link routing. Backend: 47/47 pytest cases pass (8 new in TestDocRequestsAndPending + 39 regression). Frontend: found and fixed ONE CRITICAL runtime crash in ClientPortal.jsx (AlertTriangle not imported from lucide-react) that broke the entire /portal page. After fix, pending banner, Upload-now link, wizard deep-link, admin DocRequestsPanel all work end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Used <AlertTriangle/> without importing it from lucide-react — page crashed with 'AlertTriangle is not defined' ReferenceError inside ClientPortal.map render, breaking entire /portal route for all clients. FIXED in this iteration by adding AlertTriangle to the import.

action_items: (INFO) None — the AlertTriangle crash was fixed by testing agent (1-line import).

Suggest running a lint rule like eslint-plugin-react/jsx-no-undef to catch missing icon imports before shipping (this is the 2nd time the same class of bug could have occurred; see iteration 2 review).
(Nice to have) AdminCaseDetail's 'Client-facing outstanding items' section shows only doc-related pending items — consider also surfacing the count directly in the status bar for admin quick-glance.

(Nice to have) In the Admin DocRequestsPanel, the request dialog 'Note' field placeholder is clear, but there's no indicator in the outstanding-request row when a note was attached — consider showing the note inline so admins remember what they asked for.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _compute_pending (line 908): Correct — only returns items with kind in {required_doc, requested_doc} and filters fulfilled/cancelled. No 'asset' kind tracked, matching spec.

server.py upload_document auto-fulfill (line 974): Only fulfills ONE matching request per upload via `break`. If admin requested 2 bank_statements and client uploads 2 files, the second upload will fulfill the second request correctly because of sequential calls. Good.

server.py admin_create_doc_request (line 1394-1396): The `if body.doc_type not in ALLOWED_DOC_TYPES and body.doc_type != 'other': pass` is a dead conditional — it evaluates but does nothing. Remove or replace with actual validation. Currently ANY string is accepted as doc_type. Low risk since admin-only.
server.py DocRequestCreate pydantic model has no max-length on note — could become abuse vector from compromised admin. Low risk.
ClientPortal.jsx: fix applied — AlertTriangle now imported from lucide-react.

IntakeWizard.jsx uses useSearchParams correctly and falls back to earliest incomplete step when requested step's prerequisites are unmet — verified visually: /intake/<id>?step=documents with empty case lands on Grantors step (Step 1 of 8). Correct behavior per spec.
DocRequestsPanel.jsx uses native <select> consistent with other dialogs — acceptable pattern used elsewhere in admin UI.
Resend email status: no new 'Resend send failed' errors during this iteration's test run. Only pre-existing April 18 errors remain in logs (noted in iteration 2).

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE of /portal crash: ClientPortal.jsx was updated in this iteration to render an 'Action required' pending banner using the AlertTriangle icon, but the author forgot to add AlertTriangle to the lucide-react import list on line 5. React rendered the JSX, hit the undefined reference inside the .map callback over mine.map(c => ...) for each case with pending items, and threw ReferenceError which propagated up as an uncaught runtime error covering the entire dashboard. REPRODUCTION: login as any client with a case that has pending_items > 0. MITIGATION: added AlertTriangle to the import. Verified post-fix: /portal renders, banner shows '3 item(s) still needed' with bullet list + Upload-now button, clicking navigates to /intake/<id>?step=documents.
